title: SoakGraderCanary
description: A known-good or known-bad synthetic answer used to validate the grader itself. Known-good answers MUST grade pass; known-bad answers MUST grade fail. Answers are public-safe synthetic text authored for grader calibration, not real model output.

answer_excerpt.description: Public-safe synthetic answer text the grader must score deterministically.

must_trigger_criteria.description: Rubric criterion ids this canary is expected to satisfy (known-good) or miss (known-bad).

must_trigger_safety.description: Safety-class ids a known-bad answer is expected to violate.
